job.title: Product Development Engineer
job.description:
Product Development Engineer - Wilshire - Circa £50,000+ Benefits

 

Elastic is proud to be partnering with an innovative and design-led manufacturing business to recruit a Product Development Engineer. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a collaborative R&D environment where creativity, problem-solving, and fresh thinking are actively encouraged.

 

You’ll be part of a close-knit engineering team, working on the development of high-quality physical products across a variety of materials and manufacturing processes.

 

The Role

 

As a Product Development Engineer, you will:

 

  • Design and develop new products from concept through to production
  • Work across multiple manufacturing processes including injection moulding, pressure die casting, and fabrication
  • Use CAD (Creo preferred, but any package considered) to create and refine designs
  • Apply FEA analysis to support product performance and optimisation
  • Collaborate closely with workshop, R&D, and senior engineering colleagues
  • Bring new ideas and approaches to improve design and development processes

 

What We’re Looking For

 

  • A well-rounded engineer with experience across a variety of materials and manufacturing techniques
  • Background in product development (not overly niche or specialised in one area)
  • Experience with FEA and 3D CAD tools
  • A creative thinker who enjoys problem-solving and innovation
  • Comfortable working in a hands-on, collaborative engineering environment

 

The Team

 

You’ll be joining a team of 5, including an R&D Workshop Lead, Senior Engineer, and Principal Engineer, offering a great blend of experience and mentorship.

 

Location

 

This role requires 4 days per week onsite in Wiltshire. Candidates must be within a realistic commuting distance.

 

Why Apply?

 

  • Work on tangible, design-led products
  • Be part of a supportive and experienced engineering team
  • Opportunity to bring fresh ideas and make a real impact

 

Interested? Apply directly or send your CV to sean@elastic-ltd.com for more information.

job.title: Site Manager
job.description:
Site Manager (Civils) – District Heating (London) - up to £330 per day

I’m currently working with a fast-growing contractor in the UK’s district heating sector who are looking to appoint a Site Manager for an upcoming project in London.

The business operates as a Principal Contractor, delivering high-spec district heating infrastructure projects across the UK, combining civil and mechanical engineering expertise in a rapidly expanding heat network industry.

The Role

Reporting to the Contracts Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing site operations to ensure projects are delivered safely, on programme, to quality standards and with strong commercial performance.

You’ll lead site teams, coordinate specialist subcontractors, maintain construction programmes, ensure CDM and HSE compliance, and work closely with the client and commercial team through to project completion and handover.

Key Requirements
  • Minimum 3 years’ construction experience
  • Experience with Civils projects
  • CSCS Manager Card & SMSTS
  • Ability to manage projects with minimal supervision

If you’re an experienced Site Manager interested in the growing district heating / energy infrastructure sector, feel free to get in touch for a confidential discussion.

job.title: RF Test Engineer
job.description:
RF Test Engineer

📍 Cambridge, UK | Full-time

I’m currently partnering with an innovative, fast-growing fabless semiconductor company in Cambridge that’s developing breakthrough RF technology to simplify RF front-end architectures for mobile and connected devices.

They’re now looking to hire a hands-on RF Test Engineer to join their growing development team.

🚀 The Role

This position sits at the heart of product development — providing critical hardware measurement feedback to ensure strong correlation between simulation, design, and real-world performance. It’s a highly practical, lab-based role with strong collaboration across RF design and systems teams.

🔍 What They’re Looking For

Essential skills & experience:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or similar

  • Strong RF fundamentals: S-parameters, impedance matching, gain, noise figure, linearity

  • Experience with RF lab equipment (VNA, spectrum analysers, signal generators)

  • Hands-on 3GPP measurements (LTE and/or NR)

  • Experience developing repeatable RF test setups

  • Test automation experience (Python, MATLAB or similar)

  • Practical lab experience including PCB handling/soldering
     

If you’re an RF Engineer who enjoys being in the lab, solving real measurement challenges, and influencing next-generation RF products — I’d love to speak with you.

📩 Message me directly or apply to find out more. Josh@elastic-ltd.com

job.title: Sales Engineer
job.description:
Sales Engineer – Wireless communications - Remote EU, up to 50% travel

An innovative wireless technology company is seeking a Sales Engineer to play a hands-on role at the heart of their next-generation technology for unmanned systems.

You will be at the intersection of customer success, field engineering, and mission execution—guiding leading OEMs from first technical evaluation through field testing and real-world deployment.

As a Sales Engineer, you will own customer-facing engineering engagements, solve complex RF and networking challenges, and ensure reliable, high-performance communications in demanding environments.

What you’ll do as a Sales Engineer:

  • Lead active customer integrations 

  • Drive successful radio design-ins

  • Troubleshoot RF technology, including propagation, antennas, link budgets, EMI/EMC and more.

  • Work closely with internal teams to accelerate success

  • Travel to lead technical workshops, demos, and field activities

  • Support field deployments, testing, and validation

What success looks like as a Sales Engineer:

  • High technical win rates across customer integration programs

  • Reliable, repeatable field performance across customer projects

  • Supporting expansion into additional platforms, programs, and deployments

  • Recognition as a trusted technical advisor by key stakeholders

What we’re looking for in a Sales Engineer:

  • Prior experience in Sales Engineering, Field Applications, or customer-facing integration roles

  • Strong hands-on experience with RF systems, antennas, and wireless networking

  • Experience integrating radios into complex products

  • Comfortable working in the field, solving real-world engineering challenges

  • Strong communication skills and a high-ownership mindset

If you would like further information about the Sales Engineer opportunity or have an interest in making an application, please contact Luke Ord.

job.title: Senior Sales Manager
job.description:
Senior Sales Manager (EU) – Drone & Wireless Systems

🌍 Remote within the EU with circa 30% travel expectation

A fast-growing wireless technology company is seeking a Senior Sales Manager to drive revenue growth across the European drone and unmanned systems market.

We're looking for a proven sales leader who thrives on winning complex OEM deals and building long-term partnerships.

You’ll own the full commercial lifecycle for priority accounts, driving new client acquisition and expansion across platforms and programs. Working closely with sales, engineering and product teams, you’ll help embed advanced wireless solutions into next-generation airborne and robotic systems.

What you’ll do as a Senior Sales Manager:

  • Win new drone OEM customers and drive system integrations
  • Own and grow high-value strategic accounts end-to-end
  • Lead executive-level relationships and commercial negotiations
  • Drive opportunities from the first engagement through production scale
  • Build and manage a high-quality, forecastable pipeline
  • Act as commercial owner for complex, multi-stakeholder deals

What we’re looking for in a Senior Sales Manager:

  • B2B hardware sales experience in the drone/UAS industries
  • A strong track record of closing complex OEM and platform deals
  • Familiarity with direct OEM sales models
  • Confidence in owning large, technical opportunities independently

As the Senior Sales Manager, you'll have the opportunity to work at the cutting edge of drone connectivity and play a high-impact strategic role with European Ownership.

If you'd like to find out more information or have an interest in making an application, please contact Luke Ord.

job.title: Senior Electronics Test Engineer
job.description:

We have partnered with a global leader in the power electronics industry who is seeking a Senior Electronics Test Engineer to join their team.

 

As a Senior Electronics Test Engineer, you will:

 

  • Lead product testing activities
  • Perform failure analysis
  • Be heavily involved in teliability tests and design improvements
  • Develop new test plans and test systems 
  • Help make key decisions about new components to be implemented into existing products

 

To be considered for the Senior Electronics Test Engineer opportunity, you must have:

 

  • SMPS knowledge
  • A strong background in component-level testing
  • Have developed and executed test plans
  • Be happy to play a hands-on role in an agile team
  • Be inquisitive to find the best solution

 

If you would like more information about the Senior Electronics Test Engineer opportunity or have an interest in making an application, please contact Luke Ord.
